subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should OpenClaw core add default-off `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` as the supported recovery path for stranded `message_tool_only` finals, or should this remain diagnostics-only or move to the competing #99536 direction?
rationale: The code change is plausible, but the root config, source-channel fallback, privacy boundary, and alternative default-on PR are product choices that automation should not settle.

options.title: Accept default-off recovery after proof
options.body: Keep this PR's opt-in config shape, require live external-channel proof, and land it as the canonical #85714 repair.

options.title: Keep diagnostics-only behavior
options.body: Reject automatic retry recovery and continue recommending `automatic` delivery or stronger delivery-tool prompting instead of adding core fallback semantics.

options.title: Switch to #99536 direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR only after maintainers confirm #99536 is the preferred, landable replacement with adequate proof.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off recovery after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's opt-in config shape, require live external-channel proof, and land it as the canonical #85714 repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current warning-only behavior and are the clearest history-backed owner for deciding whether the recovery semantics should replace or extend it.
